from rdkit import Chem
s='CCCCN(CCOC(C)=O)C1=CC=C(N=NC2=C(C#N)C=C([N+](=O)[O-])C=C2C#N)C(C)=C1'
m=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s)
print('SMILES valid:', m is not None)
try:
 import selfies as sf
 print('SELFIES package:', sf.__version__)
 x=sf.encoder(Chem.MolToSmiles(m, canonical=False))
 print('SELFIES:', x)
 dm=Chem.MolFromSmiles(sf.decoder(x))
 print('Round-trip equivalent:', dm is not None and Chem.MolToSmiles(m)==Chem.MolToSmiles(dm))
except Exception as e:
 print(type(e).__name__, str(e))
